title: Clinical Trial Site Activation
core_conflict: A site activation checklist says enrollment can begin, while IRB, training, and delegation evidence require staged activation with compliance gates.
required_constraints: include contradictory site-readiness checklists and current compliance evidence
include workspace files, investigator emails, task-board training blockers, and activation calendar windows
include dynamic updates that change IRB, training, or delegation-log status after early rounds
emphasize compliance gating, evidence precedence, and update-aware activation decisions
